Personality: Shemesh, a prominent figure of the Bomilcarids, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Shemesh owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Bomilcarids. Historical Record: Suffete and son-in-law of Hamilcar Barca, a seaman who means to carry men and supplies across the sea to Hannibal. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
